display_name: Phase1 冻结恢复器锚定生成轨迹真实权重检查
description: 真实冻结 Phase1 DURA 与 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL，使用两条 L_s 源训练 IQ 验证锚定轨迹初始恒等、梯度和严格重载。
authorization: 用户要求研发更强星地恢复网络并严格限定 Phase1 地面训练、测试与 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 基座。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python/Torch CPU only, original Phase1 frozen Tri-SIG-TIME release

data.representation: Two source R07 L_s clean/received IQ pairs; native DURA computed from received only
data.label_map_ref: Phase1 six TX classes; hidden throughout restorer training
data.tx_sets_ref: Six original classes; no TX labels in restorer training
data.validation_ref: Existing complete R07 source cache, IDs compared with Tri-SIG-TIME source contract
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.actual_training_labels: One generator smoke step; no TX labels, U_s IQ, V or test IQ

permissions.regime: Two L_s source IQ records; frozen Phase1 DURA and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL
permissions.claim_scope: Two-record source numerical smoke, no accuracy or generalization claim

checkpoint.initialization: Phase1 native frozen DURA E20/4940 and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL E50/11100; new zero-output random field
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original frozen DURA release 47c264286ca689f060a3f36aafb763fe209a6f06; both original source role contracts
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Validated Phase1 source-only checkpoints; no target-trained weights
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed source rows, one numerical smoke update; no evaluation or candidate ranking

execution.stop_rule: Wrong checkpoint provenance, nonfinite result or gradient, frozen state change, strict reload mismatch or collision stops with preserved log; no automatic retry

metric_names: IQ and semantic field gradient norms
strict checkpoint reload and finite frozen-F inference

notes: 源 DURA 原生恢复在预先固定的两源视图中对 Tri-SIG clean 判断保持一致的比例分别约 95.90%／96.09%，是源内一致性而非 TX 准确率。
流模型以冻结 DURA 输出±固定噪声为起点，四步速度场以接收 IQ 为条件；零输出初始化时两条轨迹均值保持原 DURA 输出。
真实两个源 L_s 受扰样本，不读取 U_s IQ、TX 标签、V 或测试 IQ；一次检查性质的 field 优化，旧 G 与 F 永久冻结。
验证源码／路径、固定 release、源契约、真实梯度与严格重载，仅为数值可行性，不能推断星地性能。
此设计时已有 Phase1 开发测试结果被研究过程观察；未来如沿用该测试集必须披露不是独立盲测。

rows.method: DURA-anchored conditional trajectories, fixed four steps and two antithetic paths
rows.purpose: Test source-only numerical compatibility and frozen-model gradients
rows.seed_notes: Two fixed L_s; generator init 2026092701 and source perturbation 2026110112
rows.scenario: Phase1 source view01, first two L_s nonclean
rows.optimizer: AdamW for a single smoke step
rows.budget_ref: Two source records, one generator update and strict reload, no target IQ
